Apple iPhone launch event announcement dates: 2020–2025

Apple has announced its annual iPhone launch event two weeks in advance for four consecutive years. Below are the announcement dates for Apple's past six iPhone launch events, and what these dates suggest for September 2026.

Model Event announcement Event date Delta iPhone 17 Tuesday, August 26, 2025 Tuesday, September 9, 2025 14 days iPhone 16 Monday, August 26, 2024 Monday, September 9, 2024 14 days iPhone 15 Tuesday, August 29, 2023 Tuesday, September 12, 2023 14 days iPhone 14 Wednesday, August 24, 2022 Wednesday, September 7, 2022 14 days iPhone 13 Tuesday, September 7, 2021 Tuesday, September 14, 2021 7 days iPhone 12 Tuesday, October 6, 2020 Tuesday, October 13, 2020 7 days

The pandemic disrupted Apple's usual iPhone launch event schedule in 2020 and 2021. The iPhone 12 launch event was postponed to October, and Apple gave only seven days' notice for the iPhone 12 and iPhone 13 launch events.

However, since 2022, Apple's approach has been extremely consistent, with each iPhone launch event announced exactly 14 days before it takes place.

When will the iPhone 18 Pro / iPhone Ultra launch event be held?

Apple has not yet officially announced the date of its next iPhone launch event, but the most likely date at present is Wednesday, September 9.

Apple provided the first official clue this week, opening up applications for US retail employees to serve as event support experience programme staff in California. The company told employees that the event would be held in the first half of September.

Bloomberg noted that Wednesday is slightly more likely, as Monday, September 7 is Labor Day. Holding the event on a Wednesday preserves the work-day round-trip time Apple has traditionally arranged for attendees.

When will Apple announce the new iPhone launch event?

If Apple maintains the pattern of the past four years and holds the launch event on September 9, it will formally announce the date two weeks earlier, that is, on Wednesday, August 26.

Therefore, August 26 is the strongest day to predict the Apple iPhone 18 launch event invitation. Tuesday, August 25 remains another possibility, but this would create a 15-day gap rather than continuing Apple's recent 14-day pattern.

What to expect from Apple's September 2026 launch event

This year's product lineup should make this event particularly significant. Apple is expected to unveil three new flagship iPhones: the iPhone 18 Pro, the iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the first foldable iPhone, possibly named the iPhone Ultra.

The standard iPhone 18 will be conspicuously absent. Apple is expected to begin splitting its product launch schedule starting from this cycle, holding back the iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and iPhone Air 2 until spring 2027.

September has traditionally been when Apple announces new Apple Watch hardware. AirPods also sometimes appear at launch events, though they are not guaranteed an update every year.

This event will mark another first for Apple. John Ternus will take over as CEO on September 1, while Tim Cook will transition to the role of Executive Chairman of the Board, making this the first iPhone launch event of the Ternus era.
